description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains related to deadlock scenarios, including reentrant and non-reentrant grains, with methods to invoke chained calls between grains and handle reentrancy control.

classes.name: DeadlockGrain
classes.description: Contains static method to facilitate recursive chained calls between grains based on call chain parameters.

classes.name: DeadlockNonReentrantGrain
classes.description: A grain class demonstrating non-reentrant behavior with methods to call next grains in a chain.

classes.name: DeadlockReentrantGrain
classes.description: A reentrant grain class allowing multiple concurrent calls and demonstrating reentrancy control.

classes.name: CallChainReentrancyGrain
classes.description: Defines a grain for testing call chain reentrancy, with methods to invoke call chains and manage waiting/unblocking.

methods.name: CallNext
methods.description: Static method to recursively invoke the next grain in the call chain, deciding between reentrant and non-reentrant grains.

methods.name: CallNext_1
methods.description: Calls the next grain in the chain, logs activity, and supports reentrancy control.

methods.name: CallNext_2
methods.description: Calls the next grain in the chain, logs activity, and supports reentrancy control.

methods.name: CallChain
methods.description: Executes a sequence of method calls across grains as per a specified call chain, with support for different reentrancy modes.

methods.name: UnblockWaiters
methods.description: Unblocks callers waiting on the call chain by setting the unblocker task's result.
